# NKY Pressure Washing Pros

## About
NKY Pressure Washing Pros provides pressure washing and soft washing for homes and businesses in Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties): house washing, driveway and concrete cleaning, and deck and fence cleaning. Free estimates by phone: (714) 494-9486.

## Services
- Soft wash house washing (vinyl, brick, wood, stucco)
- Driveway, sidewalk, and patio concrete cleaning, including oil and rust stain treatment
- Deck and fence cleaning, with optional sealing

## Service Areas
Florence, Covington, Fort Thomas, Newport, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger, Edgewood, and Independence, Kentucky.
